visualCharacteristics.description: Centred 8/12 column FAQ list: black 16px question rows with a black +/- glyph at the right, no rules, answers indented below (10px, 40px on desktop); "Expand" / "Collapse" text toggle top right. Option load-more: first 3 rows, blue icons, "Expand all" label, teal "Load more questions" button toggling to "Hide items". Option grey: light-grey column, cobalt icons. Option blue: dark-blue questions/toggle/icons.

contentPattern.description: 1 row per FAQ: [question (plain text, not a heading) | answer rich text (paragraphs, lists, links)]. Native details/summary.
contentPattern.structure: 1 row per FAQ: [question | answer rich text]
